conditions.memory_scope: Main data RAM including the NPU window cache; parameter tables, PE registers and control queues are separate.

timing_scope.npu: Accepted calc_start through done_valid, after all AXI responses.
timing_scope.gemmini: First timed configuration command through the final fence and all AXI responses.
timing_scope.host: CPU instruction execution, layout preparation and schedule search are outside these independent-operator measurements.

conditions.dma_limit_policy: AXI4 maximum 256 beats and 4 KiB boundary

gemmini_source_adaptations.configuration: DMA completion byte count uses 16 bits for transactions through 2048 bytes

conditions.npu_physical_port_validation: BUS_WIDTH=64 compile parameter; native read byte/beat accounting; AXI protocol assertions
conditions.gemmini_physical_port_validation: Compiled data-port width assertions and observed AXI width/beat histograms

speedup_definition: Gemmini cycles / NPU cycles; values greater than one mean the NPU is faster.
utilization_definition: Logical MAC count / selected engine peak MACs per cycle / complete operator cycles. This is a throughput-derived ratio, not a sampled count of active PEs. Padding MACs remain in the logical convolution count.

dense_target.strict_condition: Each Dense item reaches 1.2x under both complete-command and first-loop-launch Gemmini timing.

gemmini_loop_launch_sensitivity.scope: Gemmini first loop-launch handshake through completion; NPU accepted calc_start through completion.

dense_target.tensor_scope: Shared synthetic tensors with exact model FC dimensions; real model inference is measured separately.
dense_target.minimum_read_service_scope: Uncompressed cold reads of A, B and INT32 bias, packed into full 8-byte beats; excludes command gaps, first response latency, computation and output. Each beat consumes the selected read-service interval.

bandwidth_definition: Observed bus-service demand = max(read_beats * read_beat_cycles, write_beats). Reads and writes are independent; narrow transfers still occupy one native bus beat. The service demand excludes first-response latency and inter-burst gaps.
